title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam praising the divine presence of Maa Jagadambika in all forms
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam praising Maa Jagadambika and highlighting her divine presence in all words, thoughts and forms. The verse conveys that every word can become an expression of praise for the Goddess, as her divine form encompasses all words and all manifestations.
Sharing a Sanskrit Subhashitam, Shri Modi wrote on X;
“तव च का किल न स्तुतिरम्बिके! सकलशब्दमयी किल ते तनुः।
निखिलमूर्तिषु मे भवदन्वयो मनसिजासु बहिःप्रसरासु च॥”
तव च का किल न स्तुतिरम्बिके! सकलशब्दमयी किल ते तनुः।

निखिलमूर्तिषु मे भवदन्वयो मनसिजासु बहिःप्रसरासु च॥ https://t.co/gh1E9Ylz9h — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 16, 2026
